title: Fix navbar 'Get In Touch' raw text and hamburger menu dropdown background

requirements.text: In the NavBar component, locate the 'Get In Touch' / 'Contact Us' navigation link that is currently rendering as raw technical text (e.g., a translation key string, escaped characters, or template literal artifact) and fix it so it renders as the correct human-readable label using the centralized translations system. The nav link must display properly in both the desktop nav and the mobile hamburger menu, and in all three language modes (English, Hindi, Marathi).

quotes: Nab.get in touch is in technical txt

acceptanceCriteria: The 'Get In Touch' / 'Contact Us' nav item renders as readable, human-readable text in the desktop navbar.
The same nav item renders correctly in the mobile hamburger menu.
The label displays correctly in all three language modes: English, Hindi, and Marathi.
No raw translation key strings, escaped characters, or template literal artifacts are visible for this nav item.

requirements.text: In the NavBar component, fix the mobile hamburger menu dropdown so that its background is always solid white (#FFFFFF) regardless of the user's scroll position on the underlying page. The dropdown panel must not be transparent, semi-transparent, or inherit the page scroll state. This must remain consistent: even if the user scrolls the background content while the mobile menu is open, the dropdown background stays solid white.

quotes: After click on him Berger menu the dropdown background colour should be white and should be consistant even if the user is scrolling the backside menu

acceptanceCriteria: Opening the hamburger menu displays a dropdown with a solid white background.
The dropdown background remains solid white when the user scrolls the background page while the menu is open.
The dropdown does not appear transparent, semi-transparent, or change appearance based on the navbar's scroll state (transparent vs. solid).
All nav links within the dropdown remain readable against the solid white background.
Behavior is consistent across mobile viewport sizes.

constraints: Do not change any section components, backend files, or unrelated frontend files.
Do not alter the centralized translations file entries beyond fixing the key lookup for the 'Get In Touch' nav label.
The immutable paths (useInternetIdentity, useActor, main.tsx, ui components) must not be modified.
nonGoals: Redesigning the navbar layout or adding new nav items.
Changing the desktop navbar scroll behavior or appearance.
Modifying any page section components (Hero, About, Products, etc.).
Updating translations for any strings other than the 'Get In Touch' nav label fix.
